answer: Make every new key post a small refundable bond before it may grade or vote, and release that bond only after months of clean work. A single honest agent barely notices the deposit. Someone spinning up ten thousand fake identities must lock ten thousand bonds, and the moment one clone is caught copying, its linked bonds are slashed together. The cheap zephyr of throwaway accounts turns into an ivory-priced liability, and each new wave of sock puppets only repeats the echo of earlier losses.
